rounds.q: How many lightning flashes happen on Earth every second?
rounds.why: About 90% of all lightning happens over land. Only 10% is over the oceans.
rounds.fun: 44 flashes a second! Earth puts on quite the light show.

rounds.q: What's the hottest air temperature ever recorded on Earth?
rounds.why: It was in Death Valley, California in 1913, at a spot 179 feet below sea level.
rounds.src: WMO, Records of Weather and Climate Extremes (as of July 2025)
rounds.fun: 134 degrees! That was one toasty summer day back in 1913.

rounds.q: About how many tornadoes hit the US in a year?
rounds.why: In May 2003 alone, 543 tornadoes hit the US, the most ever in one month.
rounds.src: NOAA Severe Storms Lab; WMO weather extremes table (2025)
rounds.fun: About 1,200 a year! That's over 3 twisters a day on average.

rounds.q: What % of Earth's surface is covered by clouds on a typical day?
rounds.why: Over land, 30% of skies are totally cloud free. Over oceans, it's under 10%.
rounds.fun: Two thirds cloudy! Earth sure loves a cozy blanket.

rounds.q: How many inches of rain does Earth's rainiest town get in a year?
rounds.why: That's Mawsynram, India. Nearby Cherrapunji once got 1,042 inches in 12 months.
rounds.src: WMO, Records of Weather and Climate Extremes (2025)
rounds.fun: 467 inches is almost 39 feet of rain. Bring a big umbrella!
